summary: Zayed International Airport (AUH) is the primary aviation gateway to Abu Dhabi and the home hub of Etihad Airways. Renamed in honor of Sheikh Zayed bin Sultan Al Nahyan, the founding father of the UAE, the airport unveiled its massive new Terminal A in late 2023, significantly expanding capacity to over 45 million passengers annually. The terminal features striking modern architecture, advanced biometric processing, and one of the largest indoor spaces of any airport in the world.
faqs:
Q: Which airlines use Zayed International Airport as a hub?
A: Etihad Airways is the principal hub carrier, operating the majority of long-haul routes from AUH, alongside numerous other international carriers.

Q: How far is the airport from downtown Abu Dhabi?
A: The airport is located approximately 30 km (19 miles) southeast of the city center, typically a 30-40 minute drive depending on traffic.

Q: Are there multiple terminals at AUH?
A: Yes, the airport has multiple terminals, with the new Terminal A handling the bulk of commercial traffic and a separate terminal serving Etihad's premium and VIP operations.

Q: Does the airport have biometric or fast-track processing?
A: Yes, Terminal A features advanced biometric boarding technology allowing passengers to pass through many checkpoints using facial recognition rather than physical documents.
